note: Scheduled blog publishing. Digests are appended for the five files the register already pinned. Nothing already recorded is replaced. No firestore.rules change.

entries.why: #531 owns the post-list status and the delete path. Desktop rows use the full Scheduled-for sentence; the existing mobile card keeps the short Draft, Scheduled, or Published word so the narrow list does not grow a new layout. Delete previews then confirms through the blog service instead of deleteDoc, and a failure is shown rather than returned silently.

#531 replaces the status select with the shadcn Publish now, Schedule, and Draft control. The editor no longer writes blog_posts. Save draft, schedule, and publish now call the blog service; schedule and publish now preview the effect and only write on confirm. The recorded colour and scale literals are unchanged.

#531 filters the member blog list with the shared read-time visibility predicate. A draft stays hidden, a scheduled post appears once its UTC instant has arrived without a status flip, and a published post with a future instant stays hidden. The tenant query and the date formatter are unchanged.

#531 applies the same read-time visibility predicate to both blog lists on the news tab, so a scheduled post does not surface in the picker or the article strip before its instant. No layout, colour, or news-post behaviour moved.

#531 gates the saved-article opener with the same visibility predicate. A saved post that is still a draft or still waiting for its scheduled instant does not open. The shell, the nav, and the element tree are otherwise untouched.
